cards.heading: Definition
cards.question: What is triage as a separate evidence pass?
cards.answer: The discipline of never letting the process that generates candidate findings also decide which of them are real: a distinct later pass re-checks each candidate against the evidence it cited.

cards.heading: Why generation can't self-verify
cards.question: Why must finding-generation and finding-verification be separate passes rather than one step?
cards.answer: They are rewarded for opposite things: generation is rewarded for coverage and accepts thin reasoning to reach a candidate, while verification gains nothing from a candidate surviving, so combining them risks the same reasoning grading its own claim.

cards.heading: De-duplication rule
cards.question: What is the de-duplication rule in evidence-recheck triage, and why is it conservative?
cards.answer: Merge only demonstrable copies of the same issue; the pass never makes a keep-or-kill call on borderline findings.

cards.heading: Uncertainty rule
cards.question: What happens to a finding the triage pass is unsure about?
cards.answer: It is downgraded in confidence and still shown to the operator as a low-confidence entry, never silently dropped.

cards.heading: Chosen failure direction
cards.question: Which error does evidence-recheck triage deliberately favor, and why?
cards.answer: A noisier report over an invisible false negative, because a missed vulnerability is invisible while a false positive is merely irritating.
